name: Wordbank: Japanese CDI (Words & Gestures, Words & Sentences)
use: The age when half of children understand or say each word; Tomo's Japanese levels (scripts/build-ja-levels.py)
attribution: Frank, Braginsky, Yurovsky & Marchman (2017), Wordbank, J. Child Language 44(3). Japanese data: Tsuji; Hagihara et al. (2023); Minagawa. Instrument: Japanese CDI (Ogura & Watamaki 2004).
note: The J-CDI developers control the instrument's distribution. Ask them before shipping a beta that contains this word list (issue: see docs/decisions.md, 2026-10-06).
